description: Wood shrinkage from a start MC to an end MC (WH-2021 Eq. 4-9: S_x = S_od × (1 − x/FSP)). Direction: tangential (board width) or radial (board thickness) or volumetric. Picks a species from the wood-species table (16 verified species) or accepts custom S_od + FSP. MC is clamped to FSP — above FSP wood doesn't change dimension.

custom_shrink_od_pct.description: Custom green→OD shrinkage %, used if no species

dimension_mm.description: Original dimension in mm (width, thickness, or volume)

name: wood_shrinkage
